purpose: Document musical instruments as game props and lore assets by mapping instrument anatomy, craft methods, geometry terms, Blender tool IDs, drawing UI tags, and book-hook rewards.

instrument_families.core_mechanics: Strings are stretched over a resonant body and excited by finger or plectrum.
Open strings run from neck to resonant soundbox, usually held by a frame and tuning pins.
A shaped windway drives air against a labium edge while holes change the effective air column.
A double reed vibrates into a bore; conical bores and flared bells give many medieval reed instruments their visual form.
A stretched skin or membrane vibrates across a frame or shell when struck.
The body itself vibrates when struck, usually through a lip, soundbow, clapper, or external striker.
Bellows, wind chests, keys, and pipes route air mechanically through tuned resonators.
A rosined wheel acts like a continuous bow while keys or tangents stop melody strings.

source_support.label: Encyclopaedia Britannica, lute
source_support.support_summary: Supports the lute family, pear-shaped body, neck, and historical instrument role.

anatomy_parts.geometry_role: rounded resonant shell built from narrow ribs
repeated long curved strips over the bowl back
thin flat top plate with a visible outline
decorative cutout or relief pattern on the soundboard
small raised strip anchoring strings on the soundboard
long narrow string support
tilted head block with tuning peg sockets
parallel curves from bridge to pegbox

craft_sequence: Set the body outline and bowl depth from a side and top reference.
Build the bowl as a mirrored rib array so each rib can stay named.
Add the soundboard as a thin top plate with a separate rose cutout or relief.
Attach bridge, neck, pegbox, pegs, and parallel string courses.
Use bevels and material slots to keep soundboard, ribs, neck, and strings visually separate.
instruments.sound_mechanics: The player-facing model only needs to imply plucked strings driving a thin soundboard and hollow body; it does not simulate acoustic response.
operator_checks: Does the bowl read as a hollow ribbed back?
Is the rose separate from the bridge and strings?
Can the string courses be counted from gameplay distance?
Are broad faces low-poly enough to edit by hand?

lore_book_hooks.player_reward: Names lute ribs, rose, bridge, and pegbox so the player can inspect or repair instrument props.
lore_book_hooks.detail_prompt: A good lute shows its maker in the curve of the bowl and the patience of the carved rose.

anatomy_parts.geometry_role: tapered resonant box on one side of the frame
visible string-bearing face on the soundbox
upper curved beam carrying tuning pins
vertical or curved frame support
linear array of differently angled string curves
small repeated pegs along the neck

craft_sequence: Draw the triangular frame envelope, soundbox taper, neck curve, and pillar line.
Build soundbox and pillar as separate named parts before strings.
Add the neck as a curved beam with tuning pin sockets.
Array strings between soundbox and neck with clear index and length changes.
Use bevels on frame edges so the silhouette reads without dense ornament.
instruments.sound_mechanics: Different string lengths imply different pitches; the model only needs clear string anchoring and a resonant soundbox.
operator_checks: Does the string fan show changing string lengths?
Is the pillar visibly separate from the soundbox?
Can the neck curve be manually edited without breaking strings?

lore_book_hooks.player_reward: Teaches the player to read neck, pillar, soundbox, and string fan as separate inspectable parts.
lore_book_hooks.detail_prompt: A harp is not a triangle drawn once; it is a frame, a box, and a fan of held tension.

craft_sequence: Build a tapered cylinder or radial stack body on one bore axis.
Cut tone holes as named boolean cylinders with stable order.
Model the window, windway slot, and labium as separate source-selected cuts.
Add shallow joint bands and mouthpiece bevels.
Assign dark material to holes so the shape reads even without high-detail interiors.
instruments.sound_mechanics: The air stream splits at the labium, while tone holes change the effective bore length; the model uses visible holes and windway anatomy only.
operator_checks: Are hole cuts ordered and named?
Does the window/labium read as a real mouthpiece feature?
Do joint bands stay shallow enough for a simple object?

lore_book_hooks.player_reward: Gives vocabulary for windway, labium, bore, and tone holes on small wind instruments.
lore_book_hooks.detail_prompt: The note begins where breath meets an edge, not where the fingers rest.

craft_sequence: Set a conical bore axis and flare diameter before placing holes.
Build body and bell as a radial or section stack with separate ring lips.
Cut tone holes from the outside along the front face.
Add reed, staple, and finger-rest detail as small named parts.
Use bevels and material slots to keep holes, bell flare, and reed readable.
instruments.sound_mechanics: The double reed vibrates into a conical bore; the model should show reed, bore taper, holes, and bell flare.
operator_checks: Does the body clearly taper toward a flared bell?
Is the reed separate from the wooden body?
Are tone holes visible after bevels?

lore_book_hooks.player_reward: Names reed, staple, conical bore, tone holes, and bell flare for inspection prompts.
lore_book_hooks.detail_prompt: A shawm is built to announce itself; its bell is a mouth turned outward.

craft_sequence: Build the hoop as a short radial stack with named front and back rims.
Add the membrane as a separate disk with slight inset from the rim.
Array tacks, lacing holes, or jingle sockets around the circumference.
Use shallow bevels so the hoop does not read as a plain cylinder.
Assign skin, wood, cord, and metal material roles separately.
instruments.sound_mechanics: A stretched membrane vibrates when struck; tension hardware and rim treatment sell the object more than acoustic simulation.
operator_checks: Does the membrane read as separate from the hoop?
Are repeated tacks or lacing evenly radial?
Can the drum be simplified by hiding optional jingles?

lore_book_hooks.player_reward: Explains hoop, membrane, tension points, and rim lips for percussion props.
lore_book_hooks.detail_prompt: The drum is a circle under stress; every tack tells the skin where to hold.

lore_book_hooks.detail_prompt: A bell keeps its power in the shape of its wall, and speaks where the clapper finds the soundbow.

craft_sequence: Build a simple case and wind chest before pipe details.

craft_sequence: Build body and keybox as low-editable solid parts.

instruments.sound_mechanics: The crank turns a rosined wheel that bows strings continuously; keys move tangents against melody strings while drones continue.
operator_checks: Is the wheel visibly connected to the crank?
